**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove the line-local matching escape hatch**

When a criterion validates a multiword Markdown assertion, the alternative “choose a phrase that does not cross a line” preserves both failures described immediately below: harmless reflow through that phrase can reject correct content, while shortening it to a same-line prefix can accept an incorrect suffix. In L6(b), require whitespace-normalized/joined text or another check covering the complete assertion; lock this with mutants where semantic-preserving reflow stays green and a wrong suffix turns red. Keep normalization within paragraph boundaries so it cannot create false matches across unrelated sections.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Allow unchanged guard criteria to pass on the base**

For packets that include unchanged regression guards, requiring every criterion to report “chưa làm” on the base is impossible: checks such as `doctrine-scan`, selftest, lint, or release verification are intentionally already green (for example, A8–A9 in `ops/specs/TRAN-CODEX-VA-SENSITIVE-r3.md`). This instruction therefore either rejects valid packet specs or encourages weakening/falsifying those guards. Limit the baseline-red requirement to criteria that measure newly introduced behavior; the mutation requirement can still supply the red case for invariant checks.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
